title: Freestanding paper towel holder 14.4-Inch Solid Brass Countertop Stand, Carolina Collection | Allied Brass
description:
Upgrade your counter with a freestanding paper towel holder that keeps a roll upright and within easy reach. This Carolina Collection countertop paper towel stand is crafted from solid brass and uses a weighted base for added stability when tearing sheets.

Highlights:
- Freestanding countertop paper towel holder (no wall mounting)
- Space-saving upright stand design
- Solid brass construction
- Felt pad helps protect surfaces from scratches
- Designer finish supports corrosion-free and rust-free performance

Specs:
- Collection/style: Carolina Collection; traditional, classic design for coordinating with traditional bathroom hardware and classic bath accessories
- Overall size: 6.5-Inch L x 6.5-Inch W x 14.4-Inch H; projection 6.5-Inch
- Product weight: 4 lb; weight capacity: 5 lb
- Assembly required: No
- Included items: Paper towel holder
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
- Finish options: Multiple designer finish options; ideal for matching Carolina pieces and heritage bathroom fixtures

_previous.title: Carolina Collection Counter Top Paper Towel Stand
_previous.description: Elegantly hold your paper towel roll on this classic traditional design paper towel stand. Its design is as functional as it is practical. The roll in the stand sits upright on the counter top allowing for space saving. It has a weight in the base to keep the unit stable as you tear off the sheets.
